checks.text: The page shows the heading "HTML Markdown Converter" and two panes labelled "Input" and "Output" separated by a draggable divider.

Typing `

Hello

` into the CodeArea in the pane labelled "Input" shows `# Hello` in the CodeArea in the pane labelled "Output".

Typing `
  • One
  • Two
` into the pane labelled "Input" shows `- One\n- Two` in the pane labelled "Output".

Typing `

Visit site

` into the pane labelled "Input" shows `Visit [site](https://example.com)` in the pane labelled "Output".

Clicking the button labelled "Copy output" after entering `

Test

` in the pane labelled "Input" puts `## Test` on the clipboard and shows the toast "Copied to clipboard".

Toggling the switch labelled "Sanitize" to off, then typing `

Safe

` into the pane labelled "Input", shows `\nSafe` in the pane labelled "Output"; toggling it back on shows `Safe` in the pane labelled "Output".

Clicking the tab labelled "Markdown to HTML" switches the conversion direction; typing `# Title` into the pane labelled "Input" shows `

Title

` in the pane labelled "Output".

Typing `
AB
` into the pane labelled "Input" shows `| A | B |` in the pane labelled "Output".

Reload keeps the text `

Hello

` in the pane labelled "Input" and `# Hello` in the pane labelled "Output", with the "Sanitize" switch still on.
